name: Aqueous & Low-Temperature Geochemistry
summary: The chemistry of natural waters and their reactions with minerals, gases and life at Earth-surface conditions.

topics.name: Water as a solvent; activity models and ionic strength
Acid-base equilibria and the carbonate system; alkalinity
Complexation and speciation of dissolved species
Redox chemistry, Eh-pH (Pourbaix) diagrams and redox ladders
Silicate weathering reactions and clay-mineral formation
Sorption, ion exchange and mineral surface chemistry
Reaction kinetics and microbially mediated reactions
Chemistry of rivers, lakes, groundwater and brines
Geochemical modelling with speciation codes (e.g. PHREEQC)
